chunks: And by this chain, it was said, Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The one who takes to a sandal, so let it be a good one.

key_terms.يَسْتَجِدْهَا: Let it be new/good (imperative form indicating recommendation)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on the quality of footwear one should acquire?
ai.summary: In the context of al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi*, this hadith instructs believers to replace worn-out footwear rather than merely repairing it, reflecting the Shia emphasis on *Ihsan* (excellence) and cleanliness (*Taharah*) in daily conduct. This directive underscores the practical application of maintaining personal dignity and ritual purity, ensuring that one's attire remains presentable for both worldly interactions and acts of worship.
